Undergraduate

Diplomë universitare is insufficient for entry. Kandidat i Shkencave (Candidate of Sciences), Masters level will be considered. A score of 8.5-9.5 from a well-ranked public institution is considered comparable to a UK 2.1 while a score of 8-8.5 is considered comparable to a UK 2.2.

Undergraduate

On successful completion of the foundation programme you'll progress into Year 2 of the main undergraduate Bachelors degree.
Applicants with the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma or British A-Levels will be considered for admission to our Bachelor degree courses. If you have high scores, you may be eligible for second year entry.
Postgraduate
Applicants who hold a Licenciado/Título Profesional (GPA 3.5+) awarded after four or more years of study will be considered for admission to a Masters degree.
Applicants who hold a Título de Maestría/Magister degree will be considered for admission to PhD study.
